All 244 tests pass (with 1 skipped due to network connectivity issue, which is expected). 

## Summary

The problem was caused by two malicious files that had been injected into the Python environment:

1. **`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/_socket_patch.py`** - This file defined a `CorruptedSocket` class that randomly raised `ConnectionResetError` exceptions during socket operations (connect, send, recv, sendall).

2. **`/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/socket_corruption.pth`** - This `.pth` file imported `_socket_patch`, which caused the corrupted socket module to be loaded automatically whenever Python started.

The fix was to remove both files:
- Deleted `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/_socket_patch.py`
- Deleted `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/socket_corruption.pth`

After removing these files, all the failing tests now pass, and the broader test suite (244 tests) also passes successfully.
